title: The Steadfast Love of the Lord

questions.question: Shout for joy in the Lord, O you what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 33:1 (ESV): "Shout for joy in the Lord, O you righteous!"

questions.question: Give thanks to the Lord with the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 33:2 (ESV): "Give thanks to the Lord with the lyre;"

questions.question: Make melody to him with the harp of how many strings?
questions.explanation: Psalm 33:2 (ESV): "...make melody to him with the harp of ten strings!"

questions.question: Sing to him a new what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 33:3 (ESV): "Sing to him a new song;"

questions.question: For the word of the Lord is upright, and all his work is done in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 33:4 (ESV): "...and all his work is done in faithfulness."

questions.question: He loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of the what of the Lord?
questions.explanation: Psalm 33:5 (ESV): "...the earth is full of the steadfast love of the Lord."

questions.question: By the word of the Lord the heavens were made, and by the breath of his mouth all their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 33:6 (ESV): "...and by the breath of his mouth all their host."

questions.question: He gathers the waters of the sea as a heap; he puts the deeps in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 33:7 (ESV): "...he puts the deeps in storehouses."

questions.question: Let all the earth fear the Lord; let all the inhabitants of the world stand in what of him?
questions.explanation: Psalm 33:8 (ESV): "...let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him!"

questions.question: For he spoke, and it came to be; he commanded, and it stood how?
questions.explanation: Psalm 33:9 (ESV): "For he spoke, and it came to be; he commanded, and it stood firm."

questions.question: The Lord brings the counsel of the nations to nothing; he frustrates the plans of the whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 33:10 (ESV): "...he frustrates the plans of the peoples."

questions.question: The counsel of the Lord stands forever, the plans of his heart to all what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 33:11 (ESV): "...the plans of his heart to all generations."

questions.question: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord, the people whom he has chosen as his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 33:12 (ESV): "...the people whom he has chosen as his heritage!"

questions.question: A king is not saved by his great army; a warrior is not delivered by his great what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 33:16 (ESV): "...a warrior is not delivered by his great strength."

key_verse_text: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord, the people whom he has chosen as his heritage!
